type Mutable<T extends readonly unknown[]> = [...T];
const copy: Mutable<readonly number[]> = [1];
copy.push(2);

type TextCopy = [...readonly string[]];
const text: TextCopy = ["old"];
text[0] = "new";

type Prefix<T extends unknown[]> = [string?, ...T];
const fixed: Prefix<[number]> = [undefined, 3];
const fixedLength: 2 = fixed.length;
const optional: Prefix<number[]> = [];

const rest: [string, ...number[]] = ["head", 4, 5, 6];
const [head, first, second, third = 0] = rest;
console.log(copy, text, fixed, fixedLength, optional.length, head, first, second.toFixed(), third);
